## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

submission.

industry domain.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

## What is Cloud Based GST, Billing & Accounting Software?

A cloud based billing software allows business to handle all their invoicing, keep tabs on payments,
and securely manage their financial information on the internet. With 32+ years of expertise,
trusted by over 10+ million businesses across every trade. Our cloud-based GST, billing & accounting
software keeps invoicing easy, data secure, and finances accurate anytime, anywhere.

Traditional billing software cannot offer this, yet cloud-based systems mean everyone on a team,
including the accountant and business owner, can work on the same materials from remotely connected
devices. Because financial processes can be shifted easily, dependency on paperwork is minimized.
Most accounting software includes the main accounting functions (ledgers, collecting payments, and
matching banks) together with features for invoicing (automatic, repeating, and reminders).

It is particularly good for companies that want to manage their cash flow easily and ensure their
books are accurate. Many billing software with GST, the updated dashboards and reporting, managers
have all the necessary information for fast and smart actions to help the business. Another main
benefit is that cloud based accounting software is designed to protect your data. Thanks to their
advanced security features, your information on these platforms is safe and relatively hard to
access by unauthorized users. This means users do not need to update the software on their own,
since changes are done automatically.

The purpose of GST billing software is to help Indian companies prepare GST-compliant invoices. It
simplifies calculating taxes, sets the correct GST rates, and makes GST invoices with important
details such as HSN/SAC codes, the organization’s GSTIN, and all tax details. Furthermore, using
[billing software][95] free lowers the chance of errors and provides automatic assistance during
returns, making the GSTR reports, managing audit records, and quickly matching data with government
platforms.

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## Top-Rated Hospital with Advanced European Healthcare Standards

Medicover Hospitals is one of the leading hospital chains in India, delivering advanced healthcare
aligned with international and European standards. Renowned for clinical excellence, cutting-edge
technology, and a patient-centric approach, the group offers a comprehensive range of healthcare
services. Its extensive network includes clinics, hospitals, specialty care centers, fertility
units, and diagnostic laboratories. Medicover Hospitals has established a strong and trusted
presence across multiple states, ensuring accessible and high-quality care for diverse patient
needs.

In Telangana, it stands among the [**Best hospitals in Hyderabad**][280], with facilities in
[**Financial District**][281] (India’s tallest 24-floor hospital) and Hitech City(Main OPD, Cancer
Institute, Robotic Centre, Fertility Block, Emergency Unit), **Secunderabad**, **Chandanagar**,
**Women and Child Hitex Charminar**, **Nizamabad**, **Warangal**, **Karimnagar**.

In Andhra Pradesh, key locations include [**Visakhapatnam - MVP**][282] with 50+ specialties),
[**Medicover Cancer Institute**][283] (Arilova), **Women & Child Hospital (Jagadamba)**,
**Vizianagaram**, **Srikakulam**, **Nellore** & **Nellore Cancer Institute**, **Kakinada**, and
**Kurnool**.

In **Maharashtra**, Medicover operates advanced centers in **Navi Mumbai**, **Nashik**,
**Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar**, **Pune**, and **Sangamner**, ensuring accessible, high-quality
healthcare across India.

Karnataka - Listed as [**Best Hospital in Whitefield, Bengaluru**][284] (351 ITPL Main Road,
Whitefield Road, Hoodi Village, Bengaluru) , **Women and Children Hospital Bangalore**

## YOUR TRUSTED SUPPLIER

There are several different types of hair loss that can affect men. By far the most common is male
pattern baldness, where hair both starts to thin at the crown of the head and recede from the
hairline. Around twenty five per cent of men will start to experience this from the age of about 21
and by the age of 50 approximately 85% of men will have some level of noticeable hair loss. Male
pattern baldness has a genetic cause and can be inherited from traits in either parent.

The technical name for this type of hair loss is androgenetic alopecia, which can affect both men
and women. Changing levels in testosterone result in the production of a molecule called DHT. Higher
levels of DHT cause the hair follicles to shrink, resulting in existing hair falling out and
preventing the re-growth of new hairs. Men have higher levels of testosterone than women which is
why changing levels have a more significant impact and why men have a greater tendency to suffer
from baldness.

Risk Free

Welcome to **MinoxidilMax**, a trusted provider of advanced hair regrowth solutions. For over 15
years, we have focused on delivering high-performance, professionally formulated products that
balance effectiveness, quality, and affordability for both men and women worldwide.

Our extensive product line includes minoxidil strengths ranging from 2% to 15%, enhanced with
complementary ingredients such as finasteride, dutasteride, and retinoic acid. These formulations
are designed to work synergistically to achieve results beyond standard hair-loss treatments. With
options tailored to different skin types and sensitivities, we offer solutions that fit individual
needs.

## Hassle Free, Pressure Free Shopping Experience

No subscriptions required—simply pay as you go for each shipment. No hassle with cancellation calls
or emails.  [Subscriptions are only offered upon customer request, after they’ve experienced and
fallen in love with our products][15]. Rest assured, there’s no need to provide your driver’s
license or other confidential information.

Whatever solution you seek, you’ll find it here.

We ship all orders in one business day. We offer a risk free 100% satisfaction guarantee. 

## Professionally Formulated with Unequaled Quality Products

Our products are developed by a team of world class scientists and manufactured using materials of
the very highest grade.

## Huge Savings

We offer an extensive array of professionally formulated hair growth products at very affordable
prices. Our goal is to provide you the finest products without compromising on the quality.

## Fast Shipping

Orders are shipped on the same day or the next business day if ordered during the weekend or a
holiday.

## Products Shipped in Discreet Packaging

All products are shipped in discreet packages to ensure our customers’ privacy.

[Order Product Now][16]

> more hair keeps coming in and getting thicker. This product is doing its job and I’m happy 🙂 *

> *After delaying doing something about my hair loss for over 5-6 years I finally decided to try a
> product. Even though I had no faith in hair growth products I thought I would give MinoxidilMax a
> go and thought when it didn’t work at least I could tell myself I tried. Boy was I wrong! Coming
> onto my 6th month now. my hair looks so much thicker and has taken a complete u-turn. Parts of my
> scalp which I…*

> **As of writing this review, it’s been almost three months to the day since I started using this

> at a loss for words, and I’m so elated that I could cry – that’s how happy I am to see my hair
> making a comeback. I’ve been suffering from hair loss for the past seven years. Undoubtedly, I’ve
> tried variou…**

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

# Fighting Hair Loss?
# The first step is education, not product purchases.

We’ll uncover how marketers manipulate data to sell us products we don’t need, why there’s no
one-size-fits-all solution for hair loss, and why hair regrowth is possible – even through natural
and conventional methods.

Learn more in our free 7-day email course.

## The Perrigo Foundation: Fostering Community Well-Being

Our Perrigo Company Charitable Foundation makes lives better by supporting local organizations where
we live and work, by bolstering educational programs, access to healthcare, and community
well-being.
* More than $30.6 million donated in the last 10 years
* More than $19.3 million in product donations to support initiatives ranging from humanitarian to
  disaster relief efforts in the last 10 years

[Perrigo Foundation Grantmaking Framework][85]

## Perrigo Careers: Passion to Make a Difference

We are looking for people dedicated to empowering consumers with health and wellness solutions to
treat conditions that can be self-managed. Your passion can help drive success. See what jobs at
Perrigo are right for you.

Our culture fosters, values and celebrates our differences, we help colleagues bring their whole
selves to work! Learn more about **Perrigo's Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
initiatives [here][86].

**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of

Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

"Using Pipelinepharma’s Subscription plan has greatly benefited our portfolio expansion. We’ve made

Stephen Cuthbertson

CEO of Costapharm

“Pipelinepharma’s responsive and user-friendly platform has greatly streamlined our product sourcing
process and facilitated valuable supplier connections. We are currently in active discussions with
several suppliers and have already established commercial relationships with two companies, with
three more agreements nearing finalization. This clearly demonstrates the platform’s effectiveness
in linking us with viable suppliers. Their excellent customer service and efficient search function
make the entire process easy and effective. We are thrilled with the results and the new business
opportunities that have arisen. We look forward to continuing our partnership with Pipelinepharma,
as they have become an essential part of our product sourcing strategy.”

Daniel Jesus Dagnino

Biosistemas (Grupo Medico Castro Diaz SC)

“Our partnership with Pipelinepharma resulted in remarkable success. In less than three months, we

## Beard growth and thickening

**Wondering how to grow a thicker beard, faster?**

Enhance the look and feel of  your beard using our clinically proven Minoxidil 10% or 5% topical
treatment. Our products stimulate hair follicles to encourage new hair growth and thickening of
existing hair. 

This unique solution will help gain your confidence back and grow a full beard without any patches
or irritation.

Since Minoxidil can start a fresh anagen phase for some of your hair follicles, it can be used to
grow a beard. It needs to be applied daily and diligently. The results may not be immediately
apparent, hence, continual application is needed. The majority of studies indicate that significant
results from minoxidil usually start to show within six months.

ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are the first FDA-approved topical treatment that is clinically

progression of hereditary hair loss.

### How do ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products work?

The exact mechanism for [ROGAINE^{®}][40] minoxidil products is uncertain, however researchers

### Where can I use ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products?
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for receding hairline**
  ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are approved for men experiencing gradual thinning or gradual hair
  loss on the top of the scalp. It is not intended for frontal baldness or receding hairline.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work for beards?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for beards has not been tested in clinical trials.
* **Does ROGAINE**^{**®**}** minoxidil products work on eyebrows?**
  ROGAINE^{®} for eyebrows has not been tested in clinical trials. Directions specifically state to

It may take at least 4 months for results to be seen, and your results and success may depend on the
proper application and dosage.

There are a few signs to look for that let you know ROGAINE^{®} minoxidil products are working.
During the first few weeks of use you may see a temporary increase in hair shedding. This is a good
sign and means that the new growth cycle is beginning, and the lost hairs are making way for the

bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

## About Us

Solisom Healthcare was founded in August 2018 by a group of seasoned, experienced techno commercial
professionals in Morbi, Gujarat (India). Solisom Healthcare aspires to emerge as a leading Active
Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Chemistry Services provider to Global Life Science Companies so as to
enable them in bringing innovative products to markets in the most effective & efficient manner in
terms of cost, quality & time. With experienced team of scientists & engineers; GLP compliant labs
and GMP manufacturing plants in Morbi, Solisom Healthcare is suitably placed to quickly supply
quality products APIs and Intermediates across the scale and solve our clients’ challenging
development, scale-up & regulatory needs by offering a broad range of development services. We are
one of the top manufacturer of Pregabalin in Gujarat, India. We offering different grade of
pregabalin like pregabalin IP, Pregabalin BP, Pregabalin EP and Pregabalin USP.

### R&D

Our Research Lab is an exclusive state-of-the-art facility that supports all our research endeavors
under one roof. We achieved economical and environment friendly manufacturing process by our full
fledge R&D facility.

### Quality

Our Quality department always adhere to ICH Q7 and WHO-GMP guideline to achieve Quality, Integrity,
Stability and safety of manufactured product in solisom healthcare.

### Environment

Manufacturing facility surrounded with more than 35% of area with green belt. Plant is equipped with
all the necessary pollution control equipments. Solisom adopted zero discharge policy.

## About Us

Solisom Healthcare was founded in August 2018 by a group of seasoned, experienced techno commercial
professionals in Morbi, Gujarat (India). Solisom Healthcare aspires to emerge as a leading Active
Pharmaceutical Ingredients & Chemistry Services provider to Global Life Science Companies so as to
enable them in bringing innovative products to markets in the most effective & efficient manner in
terms of cost, quality & time. With experienced team of scientists & engineers; GLP compliant labs
and GMP manufacturing plants in Morbi, Solisom Healthcare is suitably placed to quickly supply
quality products APIs and Intermediates across the scale and solve our clients’ challenging
development, scale-up & regulatory needs by offering a broad range of development services. We are
one of the top manufacturer of Pregabalin in Gujarat, India. We offering different grade of
pregabalin like pregabalin IP, Pregabalin BP, Pregabalin EP and Pregabalin USP.

### R&D

Our Research Lab is an exclusive state-of-the-art facility that supports all our research endeavors
under one roof. We achieved economical and environment friendly manufacturing process by our full
fledge R&D facility.

### Quality

Our Quality department always adhere to ICH Q7 and WHO-GMP guideline to achieve Quality, Integrity,
Stability and safety of manufactured product in solisom healthcare.

### Environment

Manufacturing facility surrounded with more than 35% of area with green belt. Plant is equipped with
all the necessary pollution control equipments. Solisom adopted zero discharge policy.

### OUR Products

### ACTIVE Pharmaceutical Ingredients

### [ ROSUVASTATIN CALCIUM IP/BP/USP ][23]

Category: Lipid-lowering drug, HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors.

### [ MINOXIDIL IP/BP/USP ][24]

Category: An antihypertensive and a vasodilator.

### [ QUETIAPINE FUMARATE IP/BP/USP ][25]

Category: Atypical antipsychotic medication used in the treatment of schizophrenia, bipolar
disorder, bipolar depression, and major depressive disorder.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation

landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,

record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5
billion AI-powered drug discovery collaboration, over $100 billion in M&A activity, approximately
70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

##### Fluocinonide Related Products

Fluocinonide is a synthetic glucocorticoid and derivative of fluocinolone acetonide with
anti-inflammatory and antipruritic activities. Fluocinonide is a potent glucocorticoid used

## exceeding 4600 compositions under all therapeutic categories

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited stands at the forefront of healthcare innovation and compassion. Our
commitment to improving lives is unwavering, as evidenced by our extensive range of pharmaceutical
offerings. We proudly supply prescription solutions, life-saving medications, anti-cancer
treatments, veterinary care products, trusted consumer brands, and cutting-edge CNS drugs.

Our focus extends to a wide spectrum of health concerns, including anemia, anxiety disorders, cancer
and oncology, ear infections, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, influenza, non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma,
obesity, osteoporosis, Parkinson’s disease, pneumonia, transplantation, and various common ailments.

With our headquarters nestled in the vibrant city of Mumbai, India, Taj Pharmaceuticals India
Business continues to lead the way in providing healthcare solutions that empower individuals and
communities to thrive. Join us on our journey towards a healthier, brighter future.

Taj Pharmaceuticals stands proudly as a global leader in generics, ranking among the top ten
pharmaceutical companies in India. Our legacy in the field of medicine spans over a century, and our
commitment to innovation and excellence shines through. We have taken the forefront in critical
therapeutic areas such as cancer, virology, and transplantation. What sets us apart is the
harmonious fusion of Taj Pharma’s generic and pharmaceutical divisions, backed by cutting-edge
genetic sciences, allowing us to craft personalized healthcare solutions tailored precisely to
individual patient needs.

At Taj Pharmaceuticals, our mission is clear – to alleviate suffering and elevate the quality of
life for people worldwide. We have tirelessly pursued this noble goal with unwavering patience,
dedication, imagination, and expertise. Our vision revolves around the creation of targeted
medicines and diagnostic tools, uniting to provide patients, physicians, and payers with superior,
safer, and more cost-effective healthcare solutions.

Welcome to Taj Pharmaceuticals, where a profound vision transforms into reality. We are more than
just a company; we are pioneers in Innovating Generics Healthcare.

Taj Pharmaceuticals Limited operates with an unshakable commitment to earn the trust of doctors,
patients, and customers every single day. We understand that trust is a precious currency, and we
invest daily in becoming champions for our stakeholders.

Over the past decade, Taj Pharmaceuticals Group has been diligently shaping a new paradigm in
healthcare. Throughout our organization in India, we nurture enduring relationships founded on
mutual confidence. This commitment is evident in our actions – our scientists earn trust through
groundbreaking discoveries, our sales and marketing teams work tirelessly to improve global health,
and our colleagues at every level strive to be trustworthy.

This journey demands relentless effort, impeccable execution, unwavering integrity, and transparency
from all Taj Pharmaceuticals Group members. Our global team remains resolute in expanding innovative
treatments and increasing access to quality healthcare worldwide. We aspire to excellence in three
core areas: our people, our products, and our processes.

The fruits of our labor are beginning to emerge, but we believe the best is yet to come. True
champions never relent; they tirelessly pursue better outcomes. As a healthcare company, our purpose
is to help people worldwide live better and longer lives.

Our product range encompasses a wide array of major generic drugs, spanning therapeutic categories
such as anti-cancer drugs, CNS medications, and key medicines for conditions like anemia, anxiety
disorders, heart failure, hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, and more. Taj Pharmaceuticals is dedicated to
improving the human condition by providing effective solutions for common diseases and complex
medical challenges.

Highway Road,Dist. – Valsad, Gujrat – 396142.India in the middle of the some of the major generic
players of the world. The facility has dedicated manufacturing modules for oral solid dosages
Tablet, Capsule, Small Volume Parenterals, Injection, Dry Injection, Syrups & Suspensions ,
Ointments , Dry Syrups and caters to export and domestic markets.
* A Scale up and a Commercial module for Solid dosages
* Two Modules for Sterile manufacturing
* Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
  Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area

• Class 10,000 and Class 1000 controlled conditions. 17 dedicated AHUs to control individual areas.
Terminal Hepa filters in core processing area
• Capable of wet/dry granulation, direct compression, film coating and blister/strip/alu-alu packing
• The Purified Water Distribution loop confirming to USP only
• Comprehensive utilities (Boilers, Chilled & Hot water, Air compressors, H.T Electricity incl. DG
and UPS)
• GCs, HPLCs with PDA, UV Spectrophotometers, IR, PSD, DSC
• Absolute focus on Safety, Health & Environment
• Gearing up for ISO 9001 and 14001 (EMS) certifications
• Factory cGMP, WHO, UKMHRA Approved

[ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo Contaminação por mercúrio: sintomas, como acontece e o que fazer]
Doenças e condições

## Contaminação por mercúrio: sintomas, como acontece e o que fazer

A contaminação com mercúrio pode causar lesões permanentes em diversos tecidos, mas os sintomas só
surgem meses ou anos após a exposição, sendo importante que o médico seja consultado. Conheça os
sintomas de intoxicação por mercúrio, como acontece, o que fazer e tratamento.

][103] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo Toxoplasmose: o que é, sintomas, transmissão e tratamento]
Toxoplasmose

## Toxoplasmose: o que é, sintomas, transmissão e tratamento

A toxoplasmose é uma infecção causada pelo parasita Toxoplasma gondii e que pode ser transmitida
através do consumo de alimentos e água contaminados ou pelo contato com fezes de gatos infectados.
Conheça o que é a toxoplasmose, os sintomas, a transmissão e o tratamento.

][104]
[ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo 11 canetas para emagrecer: quais são, como funcionam (e qual a
melhor)]
Emagrecer

### 11 canetas para emagrecer: quais são, como funcionam (e qual a melhor)

As canetas para emagrecer são remédios injetáveis, como Ozempic, Victoza ou Mounjaro, indicados para
a perda de peso nos casos de obesidade ou sobrepeso, pois reduzem o apetite, levando ao
emagrecimento. Veja quais são as canetas emagrecedoras, como funcionam, como usar e efeitos
colaterais.

][105] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo Alopecia areata: o que é, sintomas, causas e tratamento]
Alopecia

### Alopecia areata: o que é, sintomas, causas e tratamento

A alopécia areata é a queda de cabelo em formato circular que acontece principalmente no couro
cabeludo, podendo afetar também outras regiões do corpo, como barba, sobrancelhas, cílios ou pernas.
Entenda o que é alopecia areata, sintomas, diagnóstico, causas e tratamento e cura.

][106] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo GLP-1: o que é, funções e medicamentos]
Bulas e remédios

### GLP-1: o que é, funções e medicamentos

O GLP-1 é um hormônio natural que atua regulando o metabolismo da glicose e controlando a fome. Esse
hormônio também é encontrado na forma de medicamentos, podendo ser indicado para ajudar no
tratamento da diabetes tipo 2 e obesidade, por exemplo. Saiba o que é o GLP-1, as funções e

][107] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo 8 exames para detectar o câncer de intestino]
Doenças e condições

### 8 exames para detectar o câncer de intestino

Para identificar o câncer de intestino, o médico pode indicar a realização de colonoscopia, pesquisa
de sangue oculto nas fezes, enema opaco e retossigmoidoscopia, por exemplo. Veja mais sobre os
exames indicados para detectar o câncer de intestino.

## Canetas para emagrecer: entenda antes de usar

Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro e outras canetas viraram assunto, mas usar sem informação é arriscado. O
Tua Saúde preparou um guia prático e seguro que explica como elas funcionam, quem pode usar, efeitos
colaterais e cuidados essenciais. Saiba tudo antes de decidir.

[ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo 10 pomadas anti-inflamatórias (indicações e como usar)]
Bulas e remédios

### 10 pomadas anti-inflamatórias (indicações e como usar)

Algumas pomadas anti-inflamatórias, como salicilato de metila, diclofenaco dietilamônio,
triancinolona acetonida ou pivalato de fluocortolona podem ser usadas para dor muscular, artrite,
dor nas costas, aftas ou hemorroidas. Veja as principais pomadas anti-inflamatórias, quando são
indicadas e como usar corretamente.

][112] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo 18 efeitos colaterais do Mounjaro (e o que fazer)]
Sintomas

### 18 efeitos colaterais do Mounjaro (e o que fazer)

Alguns efeitos colaterais comuns do Mounjaro incluem náuseas e vômitos, diarreia, prisão de ventre,
dor abdominal e excesso de gases. Entretanto, este remédio também pode causar efeitos colaterais
graves, como hipoglicemia, pancreatite aguda e desnutrição. Conheça os efeitos colaterais do
Mounjaro e saiba o que fazer.

][113] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo Valores de colesterol: LDL, HDL, VLDL, não-HDL e total (com
calculadora)]
Colesterol

### Valores de colesterol: LDL, HDL, VLDL, não-HDL e total (com calculadora)

Os valores de referência de colesterol variam de acordo com o seu tipo e, especialmente para o LDL,
depende do risco cardiovascular da pessoa, que normalmente é avaliado pelo cardiologista. Confira os
valores de referência de colesterol LDL, HDL, VLDL e total e o que significam.

][114] [ [Imagem ilustrativa do artigo 10 formas para fazer descer a menstruação (mais rápido!)]
Menstruação

### 10 formas para fazer descer a menstruação (mais rápido!)

Algumas formas de fazer a menstruação descer mais rápido são utilizar remédios anticoncepcionais,
reduzir atividades físicas intensas, ou fazer alterações na dieta, para regular os níveis hormonais.
Confira algumas opções para fazer a menstruação descer mais rapidamente.

Alimentos

### 12 benefícios da beterraba e como consumir (com receitas)

A beterraba é um vegetal que traz vários benefícios para a saúde, desde prevenir o câncer, até
diminuir a pressão alta, combater a prisão de ventre e aumentar a imunidade. Conheça outros
benefícios da beterraba e veja como usar esse alimento no dia a dia com receitas saudáveis e
saborosas.

## Contaminação por mercúrio: sintomas, como acontece e o que fazer

A contaminação com mercúrio pode causar lesões permanentes em diversos tecidos, mas os sintomas só
surgem meses ou anos após a exposição, sendo importante que o médico seja consultado. Conheça os
sintomas de intoxicação por mercúrio, como acontece, o que fazer e tratamento.

## Toxoplasmose: o que é, sintomas, transmissão e tratamento

A toxoplasmose é uma infecção causada pelo parasita Toxoplasma gondii e que pode ser transmitida
através do consumo de alimentos e água contaminados ou pelo contato com fezes de gatos infectados.
Conheça o que é a toxoplasmose, os sintomas, a transmissão e o tratamento.

emagrecimento. Veja quais são as canetas emagrecedoras, como funcionam, como usar e efeitos
colaterais.

cabeludo, podendo afetar também outras regiões do corpo, como barba, sobrancelhas, cílios ou pernas.
Entenda o que é alopecia areata, sintomas, diagnóstico, causas e tratamento e cura.

### 18 efeitos colaterais do Mounjaro (e o que fazer)

Alguns efeitos colaterais comuns do Mounjaro incluem náuseas e vômitos, diarreia, prisão de ventre,
dor abdominal e excesso de gases. Entretanto, este remédio também pode causar efeitos colaterais
graves, como hipoglicemia, pancreatite aguda e desnutrição. Conheça os efeitos colaterais do
Mounjaro e saiba o que fazer.

## Hair Transplant Surgeons & Specialists

Wimpole Clinic is an award winning hair transplant clinic in the UK, with surgical theatres located
in the heart of [London][162], [Birmingham][163], [Manchester][164],
[Newcastle][165], and [Nottingham][166], among other UK cities. In addition, we have pre and post-op
clinics for consultations and aftercare in [Oxford][167], [Bristol][168],
[Brighton][169], [Leicester][170], and other locations in the UK, US, and Europe.

We pride ourselves on utilising the very latest [Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE)][171] and
[Follicular Unit Transplant (FUT)][172] hair restoration techniques which have been finely
researched and proven safe and highly effective in producing natural and excellently tailored
results.

We offer a welcoming environment for our patients. Our dedicated staff are friendly, professional
and committed to providing an excellent standard of care for patients, from the moment they walk in
to the moment they leave us – and right through ongoing aftercare and follow up reviews.

Our clinic is registered with [The Care Quality Commission][173] and we work with some of the most
prominent surgeons in the UK licensed under the [General Medical Council][174]. We have a limited
number of consultations each day so you will never feel rushed. For more than 50 years we have
prioritised patient welfare and comfort in every hair restoration surgery procedure or treatment we
provide – and we always will.

## Surgical Hair Restoration Solutions

We offer a range of surgical techniques and treatments to help restore your hairline, increase hair
density, enhance crown coverage, restore overplucked eyebrows, and help you grow a full beard. 

[FUE Hair Transplant Treatment London][FUE Hair Transplant Treatment London]
[FUE Hair Transplants][179]

FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) involves removing groups of healthy hair follicles from the donor
area and reimplanting them into the bald or thinning areas. FUE is ideal for patients looking for
faster recovery times and minimal scarring. Patients can wear their hair as short as they want in
the future without any scar tissue showing.

[ Find Out More ][180]
[FUT Hair Transplant Treatment Room][FUT Hair Transplant Treatment Room]
[FUT Hair Transplants][181]

FUT (Follicular Unit Transplantation), also known as FUSS (Follicular Unit Strip Surgery), is ideal
for candidates seeking a more affordable hair restoration solution, or those who have limited hair
availability in the donor area and require a higher rate of follicle survival. FUT is more suitable
for patients who wear their hair long as it will hide the FUT scar. 

[ Find Out More ][182]
[Wimpole Beard Transplant London][Wimpole Beard Transplant London]
[Beard Transplants][183]

A beard transplant is carried out using either FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) or FUT (Follicular
Unit Transplantation). Both yield excellent results but offer different advantages. A beard
transplant can completely alter the appearance of your face, giving it a more contoured line and a
fuller, more neatly shaved look. Find out more about getting a beard transplant.

[ Find Out More ][184]
[Wimpole Eyebrow Transplant London][Wimpole Eyebrow Transplant London]
[Eyebrow Transplants][185]

Eyebrow transplant is a simple, straightforward procedure, with minimal recovery time and permanent
results that you can design with the help of our eyebrow specialists. Thanks to modern technology
and medical advances used in the leading specialised hair transplant clinics, an eyebrow transplant
is a great solution for both men and women.

Book a consultation at your most convenient hair transplant clinic location - Learn more

The Wimpole Clinic is proud to have expanded nationwide and internationally, with more than 20
clinics now open across the UK, Europe, and the U.S.

Patients can attend their pre- and post-operative appointments at a convenient clinic close to home,
travelling to one of our elite UK surgical locations only for the FUE or FUT procedure itself. It
makes planning and recovering from a hair transplant safe, comfortable, and convenient, while giving
you access to some of the UK’s most skilled and experienced [hair transplant surgeons][159].

Plus, our international expansion means more patients than ever can combine the comfort and
convenience of home planning and recovery with a 5* vacation. 

See all our [hair transplant clinic locations][160], then [book a consultation][161] at your
preferred clinic to meet our friendly, knowledgeable patient advisors.

## Hair Transplant Surgeons & Specialists

Wimpole Clinic is an award winning hair transplant clinic in the UK, with surgical theatres located
in the heart of [London][162], [Birmingham][163], [Manchester][164],
[Newcastle][165], and [Nottingham][166], among other UK cities. In addition, we have pre and post-op
clinics for consultations and aftercare in [Oxford][167], [Bristol][168],
[Brighton][169], [Leicester][170], and other locations in the UK, US, and Europe.

We pride ourselves on utilising the very latest [Follicular Unit Extraction (FUE)][171] and
[Follicular Unit Transplant (FUT)][172] hair restoration techniques which have been finely
researched and proven safe and highly effective in producing natural and excellently tailored
results.

We offer a welcoming environment for our patients. Our dedicated staff are friendly, professional
and committed to providing an excellent standard of care for patients, from the moment they walk in
to the moment they leave us – and right through ongoing aftercare and follow up reviews.

Our clinic is registered with [The Care Quality Commission][173] and we work with some of the most
prominent surgeons in the UK licensed under the [General Medical Council][174]. We have a limited
number of consultations each day so you will never feel rushed. For more than 50 years we have
prioritised patient welfare and comfort in every hair restoration surgery procedure or treatment we
provide – and we always will.

## Surgical Hair Restoration Solutions

We offer a range of surgical techniques and treatments to help restore your hairline, increase hair
density, enhance crown coverage, restore overplucked eyebrows, and help you grow a full beard. 

[FUE Hair Transplant Treatment London][FUE Hair Transplant Treatment London]
[FUE Hair Transplants][179]

FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) involves removing groups of healthy hair follicles from the donor
area and reimplanting them into the bald or thinning areas. FUE is ideal for patients looking for
faster recovery times and minimal scarring. Patients can wear their hair as short as they want in
the future without any scar tissue showing.

[ Find Out More ][180]
[FUT Hair Transplant Treatment Room][FUT Hair Transplant Treatment Room]
[FUT Hair Transplants][181]

FUT (Follicular Unit Transplantation), also known as FUSS (Follicular Unit Strip Surgery), is ideal
for candidates seeking a more affordable hair restoration solution, or those who have limited hair
availability in the donor area and require a higher rate of follicle survival. FUT is more suitable
for patients who wear their hair long as it will hide the FUT scar. 

[ Find Out More ][182]
[Wimpole Beard Transplant London][Wimpole Beard Transplant London]
[Beard Transplants][183]

A beard transplant is carried out using either FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) or FUT (Follicular
Unit Transplantation). Both yield excellent results but offer different advantages. A beard
transplant can completely alter the appearance of your face, giving it a more contoured line and a
fuller, more neatly shaved look. Find out more about getting a beard transplant.

[ Find Out More ][184]
[Wimpole Eyebrow Transplant London][Wimpole Eyebrow Transplant London]
[Eyebrow Transplants][185]

Eyebrow transplant is a simple, straightforward procedure, with minimal recovery time and permanent
results that you can design with the help of our eyebrow specialists. Thanks to modern technology
and medical advances used in the leading specialised hair transplant clinics, an eyebrow transplant
is a great solution for both men and women.

[About us][13]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
